name: Purple Dragon Commandant

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Reference-only: Requires Purple Dragon Rook or Martial Weapon proficiency; check this either/or prerequisite manually. Bonus Action grants a visible ally within 30 feet 2d6 + increased-ability modifier Temporary HP, PB times per Long Rest. While Bloodied, attack rolls have Advantage.
